title: NumberdBlocks
description: 🔢 This mod adds decorative number blocks to Minecraft, letting you use numbers to build signs, displays, scoreboards, and other creative decorations. 🎮✨
body:
🔢 Adds decorative number blocks from 0–9 to Minecraft, perfect for bringing more creativity to your builds! Use them to create signs, scoreboards, pixel art, dates, house numbers, mini-games, and many other unique decorations.

🎨 Each number block is designed to fit naturally into the Minecraft style, making them great for both survival and creative worlds. Whether you're building a city, arcade, school, or custom map, these number blocks add extra detail and personality to your creations.

✨ Simple, fun, and perfect for builders who want more decorative options.

🎮 Enjoy and have fun building!
